title: feat: add Phone module — call management, contacts & lead disposition
body:
## Summary

Adds a new **Phone** module to the CRM sidebar (below Dashboard) for managing calls, contacts, and lead dispositions. This does NOT replace the Conversation Board — it provides a focused phone-management view for organizing call activity.

**New file: `app/crm/phone/page.tsx`**

Tabbed interface with:
- **All Calls** — every call sorted by most recent, showing customer name, phone, direction icon, status badge, duration, timestamp
- **Inbound / Outbound / Missed** — filtered call views
- **Contacts** — all phone contacts with call count, last call date; clicking opens a side panel with activity history and related jobs
- **Leads** — calls with dispositions assigned, filterable by disposition type

Key features:
- `listConversationEvents()` + `subscribeToConversationEvents()` for data (reuses existing Twilio infrastructure)
- `matchCustomerByPhone()` resolves phone numbers to customer names
- Lead Disposition system: New Lead, No Answer, Left Voicemail, Follow Up Required, Appointment Scheduled, Estimate Scheduled, Proposal Sent, Won, Lost, Do Not Contact, Spam (stored in localStorage)
- Contact side panel shows related jobs from `getCachedCrewData()` and full call history for that number
- Fast search across names, phone numbers, and dispositions
- Skeleton loader during initial data load
- Real-time updates via existing Supabase subscription

**Navigation change (`CrmShell.tsx`):**
```diff
+ { href: "/crm/phone", label: "Phone", shortLabel: "Phone", icon: Phone },
```

No backend, database, API route, or business logic changes. Does not duplicate Conversation Board functionality.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7b6dcefc10124c5eac525050a143166f
